Allen Says AI Safety Must Keep Pace With Model Releases
videos.description: Greg Allen, Founder and CEO of Decision Tree Research, says AI has already had “extremely concerning incidents” and model releases should not be “exceeding our pace of safety technologies." Allen discusses concerns about AI models leaving tools for themselves across the internet and the challenge posed by open-source models as their capabilities increase. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Budrys: NATO Must Boost Deterrence After Drone Incidents
videos.description: Kęstutis Budrys, Lithuanian Foreign Minister, says a Russian drone flew from Belarus into Lithuanian airspace as NATO has experienced more than 60 incidents involving drones or missiles entering its airspace. Budrys says the alliance should show the strength, the commitment, and draw the red line. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Kloza on Diesel Prices Hit Fresh Record-High
videos.description: Tom Kloza, Founder and Chairman of Kloza Advisors and Independent Oil Analyst, says everybody still obsesses with the crude oil price, but it’s the diesel price that needs to be watched. Kloza says US refineries are running at 97% to 98% of capacity. Kloza also calls a potential diesel export ban “a nuclear option.” He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
